catalog.definition_yaml:
version: 2

# dbt Core 1.12+ semantic YAML. All metric calculations live here.
models:
  - name: fct_commits
    description: "중복 수집·merge·bot을 제외한 커밋. LOC는 코드 파일의 집계 대상 추가/삭제 행."
    semantic_model:
      enabled: true
      name: commits
    agg_time_dimension: committed_date
    columns:
      - name: commit_key
        entity:
          name: commit
          type: primary
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: commit_sha
        dimension:
          type: categorical
      - name: committed_date
        granularity: day
        dimension:
          type: time
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: organization
        dimension:
          type: categorical
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: repository
        dimension:
          type: categorical
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: agent
        dimension:
          type: categorical
        data_tests: [not_null]
    metrics:
      - name: commit_loc
        label: Commit LOC
        description: "커밋에 추가된 집계 대상 코드 줄 수. 삭제 행은 포함하지 않음."
        type: simple
        agg: sum
        expr: added_loc
      - name: ai_loc
        label: AI LOC
        description: "Commit LOC 중 AI 작성으로 식별된 추가 코드 줄 수."
        type: simple
        agg: sum
        expr: ai_added_loc
      - name: commit_count
        label: Commit 수
        description: "저장소와 SHA 조합으로 중복 제거한 커밋 수."
        type: simple
        agg: count_distinct
        expr: commit_key
      - name: deleted_loc
        label: Deleted LOC
        description: "집계 대상 삭제 코드 줄 수."
        type: simple
        agg: sum
        expr: deleted_loc

  - name: time_spine
    time_spine:
      standard_granularity_column: date_day
    columns:
      - name: date_day
        granularity: day
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]

metrics:
  - name: ai_share
    label: AI 코드 비중
    description: "SUM(AI LOC) / SUM(Commit LOC). 커밋별 비율의 단순 평균이 아님. 0분모는 NULL."
    type: ratio
    numerator: ai_loc
    denominator: commit_loc
  - name: human_loc
    label: Human LOC
    description: "Commit LOC - AI LOC. 본 샘플은 모든 추가 행의 귀속을 알고 있다고 가정."
    type: derived
    expr: commit_loc - ai_loc
    input_metrics:
      - name: commit_loc
      - name: ai_loc
  - name: loc_per_commit
    label: LOC / Commit
    description: "Commit LOC / Commit 수."
    type: ratio
    numerator: commit_loc
    denominator: commit_count
  - name: churn_loc
    label: 변경 LOC
    description: "추가 LOC + 삭제 LOC. Commit LOC와 구분."
    type: derived
    expr: commit_loc + deleted_loc
    input_metrics:
      - name: commit_loc
      - name: deleted_loc

-- Combine Aggregated Outputs
-- Order By [] Limit 2000
-- Write to DataTable
WITH sma_10001_cte AS (
  -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'commits'
  -- Metric Time Dimension 'committed_date'
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', committed_date) AS metric_time__day
    , added_loc AS __commit_loc
    , ai_added_loc AS __ai_loc
    , commit_key AS __commit_count
    , deleted_loc AS __deleted_loc
  FROM "ai_loc"."main"."fct_commits" commits_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_10.commit_loc) AS commit_loc
  , MAX(subq_10.ai_loc) AS ai_loc
  , MAX(subq_10.commit_count) AS commit_count
  , MAX(subq_10.deleted_loc) AS deleted_loc
  , MAX(subq_17.human_loc) AS human_loc
  , MAX(subq_17.ai_share) AS ai_share
  , MAX(subq_17.loc_per_commit) AS loc_per_commit
  , MAX(subq_17.churn_loc) AS churn_loc
FROM (
  -- Read From CTE For node_id=sma_10001
  -- Constrain Time Range to [2026-10-05T00:00:00, 2026-11-01T00:00:00]
  -- Select: ['__commit_loc', '__ai_loc', '__commit_count', '__deleted_loc']
  -- Select: ['__commit_loc', '__ai_loc', '__commit_count', '__deleted_loc']

  -- Compute Metrics via Expressions
  SELECT
    SUM(__commit_loc) AS commit_loc
    , SUM(__ai_loc) AS ai_loc
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __commit_count) AS commit_count
    , SUM(__deleted_loc) AS deleted_loc
  FROM sma_10001_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-10-05' AND '2026-11-01'

  -- Compute Metrics via Expressions
